thesis: Pre-open headlines for 2026-09-09 emphasize rising inflationary and interest rate pressures, headlined by crude oil pushing toward $100 on Middle East flare-ups, 30-year fixed mortgage rates reaching multi-month highs, and bond market sell-off headwinds impacting corporate earnings commentary. Corporate announcements in the pack (Bloom Energy S&P 500 inclusion, Altria capex, NextEra-Dominion merger approval, Flex AI power bet) do not offer actionable catalysts for broad portfolio rebalancing in our tradable universe. Our balanced 4-position book—anchored by core equity VTI, fixed-income ballast BND, and technology growth in NVDA and XLK—remains properly diversified (cap 6), maintains conservative single-name sizing well under the 35% cap (VTI ~28%, NVDA ~18%), and preserves $35.00 cash (~32% of equity vs the 15% floor) to absorb macro and rate volatility without unnecessary turnover.
